name: Neptune
description: This Test Connection validates access against Neptune and the availability of the configured graph model.

steps.name: CheckAccess
steps.description: Validate that we can reach the Neptune endpoint and run a query for the configured graph model with the configured AWS credentials.
steps.errorMessage: Failed to connect to Neptune, please validate the host, port, AWS credentials and the neptune-db:ReadDataViaQuery permission.

steps.name: GetPropertyGraphSchema
steps.description: Property graphs only: read neptune.graph.pg_schema() without starting a computation.
steps.errorMessage: Failed to read the property graph schema, please validate that the engine supports neptune.graph.pg_schema().

steps.name: GetRDFGraphSummary
steps.description: RDF graphs only: read the RDF graph summary in basic mode.
steps.errorMessage: Failed to read the RDF graph summary; check neptune-db:GetGraphSummary and DFE statistics.

steps.name: GetNodeLabels
steps.description: List the node labels from the property graph schema.
steps.errorMessage: Failed to read node labels from the property graph schema.

steps.name: GetRelationshipTypes
steps.description: List the edge labels from the property graph schema.
steps.errorMessage: Failed to read edge labels from the property graph schema.
